verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships an official 'Wizard CLI' that auto-detects frameworks, installs SDKs, and instruments a codebase from one terminal command (amplitude-docs-1, amplitude-docs-27), which qualifies as an official CLI. However, it is positioned as a setup/instrumentation tool rather than an AI-native/agentic CLI for broader workflows, and no evidence shows scripting, automation, or agent-integration use cases for the CLI itself. missing for 10: evidence the CLI supports agentic/automation workflows beyond initial setup, independent hands-on verification, and any AI-specific CLI commands.
